description: The birds are eating the signage again and the ad revenue with it. Chase the pigeons off Foundry Way, Cinder Lane, and Marrow Street. Flap your arms. Lose your dignity. Keep the credits. 15₵.
name: Pigeon Patrol

emotes: {who} flaps both arms at Foundry Way signage and hisses like a much larger animal.
{who} lobs a chunk of grit at a pigeon, misses, and startles a whole flock into the air.
{who} stares down a single fat pigeon that refuses, on principle, to move.
{who} shoos pigeons off Cinder Lane letters, and they resettle two letters over immediately.
{who} bangs a stick on the hoarding and a grey cloud erupts off the sign.
{who} makes eye contact with the flock leader. An understanding is not reached.
{who} chases the last of them off Marrow Street rail and immediately gets dive-bombed.
{who} waves their arms in wide circles until Marrow Street is, for one glorious moment, bird-free.
{who} wipes something off their shoulder, looks up, and makes their peace with the job.

objectives.desc: Wherever the flock has got to today.
emotes: {who} follows the noise two streets over and arrives to a wall of wings.
{who} runs at them with both arms out and achieves roughly four seconds of clear signage.
